secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxx.supabase.co) from the Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable API key from the Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (anon public)

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (server-side only, used by /api/auth/delete-account) from the Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (service_role)
